verdict.rationale: Increase provides building blocks for risk controls — real-time authorization decisions letting ops approve/decline card transactions (increase-docs-15, increase-docs-20), account holds that reserve funds without moving money (increase-docs-14), and Entity compliance validations (increase-docs-12, increase-docs-27) — but there is no documented feature for setting transaction/velocity limits per account or program, no explicit 'account freeze' mechanism, and no documented reinstatement workflow. missing for 10: explicit velocity/transaction limit configuration APIs, an account-freeze primitive, documented reinstatement paths after a freeze or hold, and any per-program (vs per-account) risk policy controls.
